name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring 22-26 plot workforce-synchronized land scaling frozen at Day 13 with a 9-10 hand cap, pre-seed hyper-fertilization dispatch, daytime-decoupled reinvestment velocity, protected Strawberry compounding with a 12-16 unit town shop inventory buffer, closed-loop well refills, and elevated dynamic expansion-gated liquidation floors.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, contiguous layout metrics, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks after hour 18 and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation with true livestock-scaled feed reserves (n_animals * 3) to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Prioritizes existing shed inventory and rapid Carrots (max 2 plots) while strictly barring slow single-harvest crops after Day 5, ensuring >= 90% of land compounds hyper-fertilized Strawberries.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus (>= 8-10 units) at elevated dynamic price floors (>= 0.88x base normal; >= 0.82x when shed fullness >= 65% or pre-midnight), preserving a 12-16 unit Town Shop Inventory Buffer for recurring harvest commodities to capitalize on high-multiplier arbitrage.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when glut risk is acute (risk >= 0.52, price >= 0.82x base) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into synchronized workforce and land scaling (8-10 plots by Day 4-5 with 3-4 hands; 14-16 plots by Day 8 with 6-7 hands; 22-26 contiguous plots by Day 12-13 with 9-10 hands; hard land freeze at Day 13), decoupling daytime reinvestment (1.0x payroll) to accelerate hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding with a strict Day 13 seed procurement cutoff.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict micro-dispatch sequencing: in-situ harvest-and-water recurring crops, soil preparation and pre-seed hyper-fertilization, cluster harvesting up to backpack capacity, cluster watering, closed-loop shed drop-off chained with immediate well refill, livestock feeding, and planting.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of unreserved, non-shop surplus inventory starting at hour 20 to guarantee payroll before midnight.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never hoard phantom wheat when n_animals == 0; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery; do not trigger emergency liquidation before hour 18 during normal daytime production.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 50.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 24)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Fulfill orders immediately from existing shed inventory (including the 12-16 unit Town Shop Inventory Buffer). Strictly condition seed procurement on: 1) day + crop_growth_days <= 28; 2) no slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Cauliflower, Potato) after Day 5; 3) cap rapid Carrot shop acreage to at most 2 plots, preserving >= 90% acreage for hyper-fertilized Strawberries; 4) hard seed procurement cutoff at Day 24.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase or plant slow crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Potato, Cauliflower) after Day 5, as they cannibalize high-yielding Strawberry flushes for a minor one-off premium. Do not completely abandon fast Carrot shop fulfillment or shed arbitrage, as that forfeits lucrative 2.0x-3.5x premiums to opponents. Never buy shop seeds if net available cash is below 1.25x midnight payroll. Do not hoard uncontracted surplus speculatively beyond the 12-16 unit buffer.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of >= 8-10 unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings at elevated dynamic price floors: maintain >= 0.88x base price during standard operations. Permit sales down to 0.82x base price strictly when shed fullness exceeds 65% or during hour >= 20 wage defense. Establish and protect a Town Shop Inventory Buffer of 12-16 units of recurring harvest commodities in the shed; do not liquidate below this buffer unless shed capacity > 65% or wage defense is active. Conduct terminal shed clearance strictly between steps 708-716 at a defended >= 0.74x floor.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate below the 12-16 unit Town Shop Inventory Buffer unless shed fullness > 65% or hour >= 20. Never dump bulk Strawberry harvests at sub-0.88x base price unless shed fullness exceeds 65%. Never liquidate Wheat below dynamic feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Avoid premature terminal fire-sales before step 708.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when oracle_glut_risk >= 0.52 and current_price >= 0.82 * base_price before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not front-run on hypersensitive or weak glut signals (risk < 0.52); never dump into collapsed sub-0.82 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: ((hour < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.0 + 50.0) or (hour >= 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0)) and (hired_hands < 10 or (total_plots < 26 and day <= 13) or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce dynamically alongside contiguous land across three waves: reach 8-10 plots and 3-4 hands by Day 4-5, expanding to 14-16 plots and 6-7 hands by Day 8, and reaching 22-26 contiguous plots and 9-10 hands by Day 12-13 (~2.4-2.6 plots/hand). Cap workforce at 9-10 hands to eliminate engine order dropping. Enforce a hard land expansion freeze at Day 13. Decouple daytime reinvestment between hours 04:00-17:00 by requiring only 1.0x payroll reserve + action cost. Bootstrap Days 1-4 with Carrots, transitioning all plots on Days 5-8 to hyper-fertilized Strawberries to compound across 5-6 harvest flushes. Enforce a hard Strawberry seed procurement cutoff at Day 13.
attributes.pitfalls: Never hire more than 10 hands to prevent 10-order engine cap violations and payroll bleed. Never purchase plots after Day 13 as late land expansion yields negative ROI. Never expand land when cash is below daytime reserve (1.0x payroll + plot cost before hour 18, 1.5x after hour 18). Never purchase Strawberry seeds after Day 13. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops on expanding acreage.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands following strict micro-dispatch priority: 1) In-situ Harvest & Immediate Water recurring crops (workers harvesting ripe Strawberry plots immediately water the plot in-situ if carrying water and plot is dry before departing), 2) Soil Preparation & Pre-Seed Hyper-Fertilization (apply fertilizer to tilled soil before seeding to ensure all Strawberries are hyper-fertilized), 3) Cluster Harvest adjacent ripe plots up to backpack capacity, 4) Cluster Watering of any remaining dry cultivated plots to eliminate regrowth halts, 5) Closed-Loop Shed Drop-off & Well Refill (when backpack full or hour >= 20; chain shed drop-off with an immediate central well refill so hands depart with 100% full watering cans), 6) Livestock Feeding, 7) Planting seeds (hyper-fertilized Strawberries primary; max 2 Carrot plots for active shops), 8) Till/Weed new plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allow Strawberry plots to remain unwatered post-harvest, as dry intervals freeze regrowth clocks. Never plant Strawberry seeds on unfertilized plots; always apply fertilizer prior to seed placement. Do not drop off at shed with partially full backpacks unless hour >= 20 or approaching step 716. Never fail to refill watering cans immediately after shed drop-off. Never create dispatch deadlocks if an action cannot be performed immediately; gracefully fall through priority chain. Ensure no hand idles while harvestable crops or dry plots exist.
